meeting_settings.title: Video Meeting Settings
meeting_settings.description: Values set here are reflected directly on the student's My Classroom and the app-setup page. A teacher's registered fixed link is used by default; a per-lesson URL, if registered, takes priority over it.
meeting_settings.student_platform_desc: This value is shown on the student's My Classroom.
meeting_settings.teacher_links_desc: Same values a teacher can register themselves on the Teacher Page — you can edit them here too.

accounts.title: Accounts & Permissions
accounts.description: Set what each General Administrator account can do. Anything not granted here is not only hidden from the UI but also blocked at the service layer, even if called directly.

reschedule.title: Reschedule Requests
reschedule.description: Every student-initiated reschedule, and every auto-extension caused by teacher absence, academy closure, or admin cancellation, is logged here. "End Date Before → After" shows how each change affected the enrollment's end date.

override_modal.title: Manually Change Class Schedule
override_modal.warning: This tool bypasses the normal reschedule process for data correction. Use it carefully.
override_modal.no_lessons_option: No upcoming classes available to change
override_modal.force_label: Force apply, ignoring weekly-day pattern and holiday checks (force)
override_modal.validation_error: Class, new date, and reason for change are required.
